---
title: "Phase Portraits"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(moderndive)
library(fishualize)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
M1data <- read.csv("M1J0rank.csv")
M2data <- read.csv("m2_j0rank.csv")
M3data <- read.csv("m3_j0rank.csv")

# Find global minimum and maximum prediction error
min_error <- min(
  M1data$err_norm,
  M2data$err_norm,
  M3data$err_norm,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

max_error <- max(
  M1data$err_norm,
  M2data$err_norm,
  M3data$err_norm,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
# Create phase portrait
m1j0phase <- ggplot(M1data, aes(
  x = jpos0,
  y = jvel0
)) +

  # Trajectory through phase space
  geom_path(
    aes(colour = err_norm),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +

  # Individual data points
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = err_norm),
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Zero velocity reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Custom prediction error colour scale
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "lightblue",
      "lightskyblue",
      "salmon",
      "red",
      "darkred"
    ),
    limits = c(min_error, max_error),
    name = "Prediction error"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Phase Portrait: M1 Joint 0",
    x = "Joint Position",
    y = "Joint Velocity"
  ) +

theme(text = element_text(size = 12),  axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title =             element_text(size = 12))

ggsave("phaseportrait_M1J0_nrmse.png", plot = m1j0phase, width = 12, height = 8)
print(m1j0phase)
```

```{r}
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Custom prediction error colour scale
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "lightblue",
      "lightskyblue",
      "salmon",
      "red",
      "darkred"
    ),
    limits = c(min_error, max_error),
    name = "Prediction error"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Phase Portrait: M3 Joint 6",
    x = "Joint Position",
    y = "Joint Velocity"
  ) +

   theme(text = element_text(size = 12),  axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title =             element_text(size = 12))

ggsave("phaseportrait_M3J6_nrmse.png", plot = m3j6phase, width = 12, height = 8)
print(m3j6phase)
```

```{r}
# Create phase portrait
m3j7phase <- ggplot(M3data, aes(
  x = jpos7,
  y = jvel7
)) +

  # Trajectory through phase space
  geom_path(
    aes(colour = err_norm),
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +

  # Individual data points
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = err_norm),
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Zero velocity reference line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Custom prediction error colour scale
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "lightblue",
      "lightskyblue",
      "salmon",
      "red",
      "darkred"
    ),
    limits = c(min_error, max_error),
    name = "Prediction error"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Phase Portrait: M3 Joint 7",
    x = "Joint Position",
    y = "Joint Velocity"
  ) +

   theme(text = element_text(size = 12),  axis.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.title =             element_text(size = 12))

ggsave("phaseportrait_M3J7_nrmse.png", plot = m3j7phase, width = 12, height = 8)
print(m3j7phase)
```
